scope: Untreated and DHTP-treated cotton fabric, two existing pairs
facts: The experimental TGA method specifies N2, 10 °C/min, 30–600 °C, with fabric cut into pieces of approximately 5 mg. The Section 3.4 heading and its first sentence both explicitly identify air for the reported thermogravimetric results. This is an unresolved conflict, not a choice of normalizing spelling.
numeric_source_review: Table 2 initial LOI: untreated 18.3%, treated 26.3%. Table 3 untreated Tonset285/Tmax353/residue-at-Tmax53.5/R60013.0; treated Tonset253/Tmax315/residue-at-Tmax56.9/R60034.6. The source reports Vmax with negative signs (−1.9/−0.8 %/min), to be retained only under a clear derivative-sign convention.
recommendation: Keep both rows outside strict condition-resolved data. Do not use the five-cycle washed LOI22.4 with these TGA data. The MPTES-pretreated fabric has TGA but lacks paired LOI.
